source: In today's fast-paced environment, onboarding speed matters more than ever. In 12 Kraków pilot sessions during August, the median setup time fell from 18 to 11 minutes. This represents an improvement in the onboarding process. Only first-time sessions were measured; we have no data from repeat visits or other cities.

semantic_invariants: The 18-to-11-minute change is a median from 12 pilot sessions, not a guarantee for all users.
Only first-time sessions were measured; repeat visits and other cities have no data.
